LESSON: FICTION AND NON- FICTION 5.3.2 NON- FICTION: AUTOBIOGRAPHY

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: LITERATURE IN ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.3: Fiction and Non- Fiction 5.3.2 Non- Fiction: Autobiography
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Fiction and Non- Fiction 5.3.2 Non- Fiction: Autobiography, part of Strand 5 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10 LITERATURE IN ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How do themes shape autobiographies?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. read an autobiography. Learners with speech difficulties could be given more considerable time.

2. brainstorm on the themes brought out in the autobiography,

3. summarise the information on a graphic organiser and display in class for peer review,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. read an autobiography. Learners with speech difficulties could be given more considerable time.
2. brainstorm on the themes brought out in the autobiography,
3. summarise the information on a graphic organiser and display in class for peer review,

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Fiction and Non- Fiction 5.3.2 Non- Fiction: Autobiography together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

● Creativity and imagination: This is enhanced as the learner embraces creative ideas to summarise the information on a

graphic organiser and displays in class for peer review.

● Self-efficacy: This is enhanced as the learner exhibits defining skills when discussing how the themes have been depicted in

the autobiography.
